**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/03/18 (Sat) 06:36
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The KGpip meta-learning approach is a technique for enhancing the search strategy of existing AutoML systems.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] KGpip uses large databases of machine learning (ML) pipelines associated with datasets to learn from a large scale database and achieve a high degree of coverage and diversity.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The approach uses static program analysis instead of executing the actual pipeline scripts or preparing the actual raw data.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The KGpip meta-learning component captures metadata and semantics in a flexible graph format.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] KGpip relies on graph generator models as the database of pipelines.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] KGpip mines large databases of datasets and pipelines using static analysis and filters them into ML pipelines customized for the learner selection problem.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The meta-learning approach produces MetaPip, a highly interconnected graph of seen datasets and pipelines.
